tasks.short: Investigate organism-disease relationships with traceable results

steps.what: Frame the relationship between organisms and disease to investigate and choose controls
Retrieve comparable disease, organisms and antibiotic results for the investigation
Investigate disease relationships and effects of antibiotics through the planned experimental work
Enter observations of organisms and antibiotic effects with sample and protocol references
Compare the disease and antibiotic results and interpret the relationship to organisms

tasks.design: Configure comparable-result views and experiment forms in the laboratory notebook and sample system in {OTHER}. Use a versioned comparison routine in {DATA_PLATFORM} for repeated joins and summaries, retaining experimental work, control choices and biological interpretation.
tasks.previous_blocker: Locating comparable results and repeatedly preparing joins and tables interrupts investigation.
tasks.enabler_now: Existing sample identifiers, notebook forms and versioned analysis routines can reuse measured results.
tasks.still_hard: Confounding, biological variation and distinguishing association from causation.
tasks.human_edge: Question whether apparently comparable experiments actually support the inference.

ambition.what: Compare antibiotic-response results with protocol-matched controls before choosing the next experiment.

reach.learn: Sample lineage, units and protocol comparability.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: laboratory record views and versioned result joins can reduce manual data preparation; causal interpretation and experimental execution remain scientific work.

assumptions: Boundary is a research investigation through interpreted results, not patient treatment or an epidemic-control order. This task's experimental work overlaps narrower observation tasks and must be assigned once in roll-up.

Existing laboratory staff produce sample id, organism, assay, antibiotic, concentration, unit, protocol version and observation time. The microbiologist performs experiments in s3 and captures new observations in s4; instrument values are reused only where already available. Missing identifiers and unusual units are resolved within retained s2/s4/s5 time.

Test native laboratory filters and forms first. S2 removes navigation between comparable records; s4 removes repeated protocol labels, not observation capture; s5 removes manual joins and table setup only. Existing computation runtime earns no saving, and interpretation remains in retained s5.
Ordinary notebook writes have no self-approval gate and save time is retained. The deterministic routine computes summaries, never biological conclusions.
All shares are unmeasured focal labour estimates. Incremental allowance funds mapping/routine maintenance and failed-run recovery beyond retained exceptions.
unknowns: Completeness of protocol and assay metadata.
research_questions: Which real comparisons can share units and controls without scientific reinterpretation?

already_counted.description: Protocol choice, comparability checks, experiments, source capture and interpretation remain.

incremental.description: Maintain assay mappings and comparison routines and repair failed data preparation.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Central cuts 11 retrieval, 4 repeated form labels and 10 analysis setup give 25 gross and 23.5 net. Cautious case: poor comparability leaves s2 at 85%, unusual protocols leave s4 at 80%, and bespoke analysis leaves s5 at 90%; gross 7 less upkeep 1.5 gives 5.5, above low 5.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Prepare traceable research reports and recommendations

steps.what: Assemble research outcomes and source-linked tables for technical reports
Decide the recommendations justified by the research outcomes and their limitations
Prepare technical report prose from the checked tables and recommendation outline

loop.purpose: Draft technical prose from the scientist's findings and recommendations
loop.input: Checked evidence tables, recommendation outline and template
loop.output: Draft with each quantitative claim linked to its source table
loop.check: Microbiologist checks numbers, causal wording, limitations and recommendation fidelity in s4
loop.stop: One draft; unsupported claims are removed or rewritten by the scientist
loop.why_not_simpler: Explaining findings in prose needs language composition beyond fixed table filling

steps.what: Review and revise technical reports and recommendations against the underlying research
Authorise the final technical report and recommendations for the named research recipient
Send the approved technical report and recommendations to the named recipient

tasks.design: Generate the repeated evidence tables from versioned outcomes in {DATA_PLATFORM}, then draft report prose in {DOCS} from the microbiologist's recommendation outline. The scientist checks the complete draft and the existing research lead approves its final external release before the separate send through {EMAIL}.
tasks.previous_blocker: Repeated table assembly and first-version prose compete with scientific interpretation.
tasks.enabler_now: Versioned result exports and source-constrained drafting can construct a traceable report draft.
tasks.still_hard: Make recommendations proportionate to the experimental evidence.
tasks.human_edge: State what the study does not establish.

ambition.what: Provide a source-linked limitation section alongside each research recommendation.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: versioned result exports and constrained prose drafts can reduce report assembly while retaining scientific review and release authority.

assumptions: Boundary is a routine externally delivered study report under an existing research-lead release process; confirm that process locally rather than inventing a new reviewer. Research execution and primary analysis precede this task and remain outside.

Study scientists supply validated outcome ids, sample counts, units, analysis version and limitations. S1 selects and reconciles those sources; s2 captures the scientist's actual recommendation outline. Missing metadata and nonstandard tables are repaired in retained s1/s4 time.

Native laboratory report templates are tested first. Table generation removes copying and formatting only, not analysis runtime. Prose drafting does not invent recommendations, citations or findings; unsupported output is rewritten in retained s3/s4 time with additional failure upkeep.

The final report exists before the independent lead's existing release check s5. Approval binds report, recipient and purpose for s6; edits void it. Ordinary working saves remain tiny and ungated; the manual send has no saving.
Focal B96 excludes four unchanged research-lead shares. All times are unmeasured estimates. No other-role labour saving or free additional review is claimed.
unknowns: Existing report-release authority and consistency of exported result metadata.
research_questions: Can every quantitative report statement be traced to the correct analysis version?

already_counted.description: Source reconciliation, recommendation judgement, draft repair, scientific review and send remain.
Existing independent release check is unchanged and excluded from focal savings.

incremental.description: Maintain table/report mappings and recover failed drafts beyond routine editing.

approvals.approved_version: final report, recipient and purpose snapshot approved in s5; changes void approval

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Focal B96 and R66 give 31.25 gross and 29.75 net. Cautious case: nonstandard assay tables leave s1 at 75% and complex limitations leave s3 at 90%; 8.75/96 gives 9.114 gross and 7.614 net, above low 7. Recommendation judgement and independent release remain unchanged.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Observe microbial action and capture traceable findings

steps.what: Prepare the observation protocol and controls for microorganisms acting on tissues or organic matter
Observe action of microorganisms upon living tissues, other microorganisms and dead organic matter
Record the observed action of microorganisms with sample, time and tissue references
Check the observations of microorganisms against controls and image evidence
Save the checked microorganisms observation entry in the laboratory notebook

tasks.design: Configure the observation form in the laboratory notebook in {OTHER} to reuse sample and protocol fields and link existing instrument images. Keep preparation, actual observation and control interpretation with the microbiologist; the ordinary checked-entry save remains ungated and fully retained.
tasks.previous_blocker: Repeated sample and protocol labels add clerical work to actual observations.
tasks.enabler_now: Native notebook forms can reuse existing experiment metadata and image references.
tasks.still_hard: Distinguish genuine tissue effects from contamination or preparation artefacts.
tasks.human_edge: Notice an unexpected pattern the protocol did not anticipate.

ambition.what: No increased specimen throughput is assumed.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: notebook forms can reuse experiment identifiers and image links while observation and scientific control checks remain human.

assumptions: Boundary includes specimen observation and its actual research notebook entry. It does not add a separate progress log. Overlap with whole-investigation tasks must be assigned once in roll-up.

The microbiologist sets protocol and controls in s1, produces observations and images in s2 and captures effect descriptions in s3. Existing sample registry supplies sample id, tissue type and protocol version. Missing metadata and image mismatches require manual correction in retained s3/s4 time.

Test native notebook forms first. S3 removes repeated labels and image-path copying only; observation descriptions still require capture and interpretation. S5 is a tiny same-system save with no self-approval stage or saving.
All shares are unmeasured focal labour estimates. Incremental allowance is for form and image-link corrections beyond normal per-entry checks.
unknowns: Availability of stable sample and image identifiers.
research_questions: Which repeated notebook fields can prefill without obscuring a changed specimen or protocol?

already_counted.description: Preparation, observation, finding capture, source checks and save remain.

incremental.description: Maintain the observation form and repair broken image links.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Central entry cut 6.75 less upkeep 0.5 gives 6.25. Cautious case: unusual tissues and inconsistent image labels leave s3 at 90% retained, giving 1.5 gross and 1 net. Physical observation and control checks remain unchanged.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Study microbial characteristics with reproducible data preparation

steps.what: Define the growth, structure or development question and health-related controls to study
Study growth, structure and development of bacteria and other microorganisms using the planned cultures and observations
Capture microbial growth and structure measurements with sample, time and unit metadata
Prepare growth comparisons and characteristic plots for the microorganisms study
Interpret the microorganisms findings and their relationship to human, plant and animal health

tasks.design: Test native instrument-file import and study forms in the laboratory system in {OTHER}, then use a versioned plotting recipe in {DATA_PLATFORM}. The microbiologist performs the cultures, captures manual observations and checks units, controls and biological meaning before interpreting health relevance.
tasks.previous_blocker: Retyping instrument values and rebuilding comparison plots are mixed with experimental study.
tasks.enabler_now: Native file mappings and fixed plotting recipes can reuse measurements under explicit sample and unit contracts.
tasks.still_hard: Generalise from laboratory growth to health relevance without overstating evidence.
tasks.human_edge: Know when a technically clean result has weak biological validity.

ambition.what: Compare growth trajectories with protocol-matched controls after each completed measurement series.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: supported laboratory file imports and plotting recipes can reduce retyping and repeated operator setup; experimental and biological judgement remain human.

assumptions: Boundary is one microbial-characteristics study through checked interpretation, not report publication or patient diagnosis. Research activities overlapping other task graphs must be counted once in roll-up.

The microbiologist produces instrument files and manual observations in s2. Instrument export contains sample id, measurement, unit, timestamp and instrument run id; study protocol supplies condition and control mapping. S3 retains manual observation capture and metadata reconciliation. Missing fields or incompatible exports require manual capture there.

Test native file-import configuration before code. S3 removes actual retyping of already recorded instrument values, not original observation capture or a same-system save. S4 removes repeated operator plot setup and joins, never existing calculation runtime.

S5 retains full unit/control checking and biological interpretation; failed imports and plotting exceptions are corrected in retained s3/s4/s5 time with additional recovery funded in upkeep. No autonomous scientific conclusions or external actions are introduced.
All shares are unmeasured focal labour estimates. Existing instrument operation and ordinary notebook saves remain counted without artificial approval gates.
unknowns: Instrument export compatibility and current manual retyping.
research_questions: Can the native importer preserve units and sample lineage across actual instrument files?

already_counted.description: Protocol choice, culture work, manual capture, import correction, plot checking and interpretation remain.

incremental.description: Maintain instrument mappings and plotting recipes and recover failed runs.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Central cuts 12 retyping and 5 plot setup give 17 gross and 16 net. Cautious case: legacy instrument exports cannot map, so s3 remains fully manual; reusable plot setup still saves 5, less upkeep 1 gives 4, above low 3. Experimental work and biological interpretation retain all time.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: The microbiologist keeps experimental and scientific decisions while reducing repeated preparation of traceable data and reports.
reach: Laboratory data analyst: prepare reproducible comparison tables and growth plots.
role.ambitious_version: Review comparable experimental series more frequently with explicit controls, then communicate only scientist-checked conclusions.
